status: Design comparison only; existing Garrote architecture mapping remains the active proposal
recommendation: Alvar for most civilian houses and civic details; Garrote for walls, gates, jail and royal fortifications. All geometry newly authored.
fitMeaning: Axis-aligned exterior envelope comparison, allowing a 90-degree turn. Not door, foundation, street, courtyard, collision or room-capacity approval.

entries.title: Ol’ Black Magic
entries.newGeometryIntent: Use the polygonal guild vocabulary sparingly; author a lower main hall and membership wing, with Nool still outside.

entries.title: Ogre Foundry
entries.preference: Mixed: Garrote workshop, Alvar shop frontage
entries.newGeometryIntent: Use one or two asymmetric shop bays and a Garrote-like working canopy; the whole four-way block is far too large.

entries.title: Tog’s Training / swimming annex
entries.newGeometryIntent: Shorten and narrow the hall to the reservation; keep the swimming annex separate. Its native buttressed flat roof is institutional, not a domestic default.

entries.title: Castleview Jail
entries.newGeometryIntent: Keep the fortified masonry and controlled prison threshold; Alvar cottages are not the right structural reference.

entries.title: First Drawkcab chapterhouse
entries.newGeometryIntent: Shorten the long cottage and retain two study places under one roof; plain finish without an estate tower.

entries.title: Drawkcab study house
entries.newGeometryIntent: A smaller gabled companion house with an offset door/garden side, not a mirrored duplicate.

entries.title: Milken Savings / accounts
entries.newGeometryIntent: Compact finance house with a subordinate accounts room; one bank service and Rex retain their separate roles.

entries.title: Blacksmoke Tavern
entries.newGeometryIntent: New main guest room and lower entrance wing; reduce depth to preserve the street and shared court.

entries.title: Adventurers’ lodging
entries.newGeometryIntent: Borrow unequal connected wings; omit the estate tower and reduce the footprint for shared modest lodging.

entries.title: Mapmakers’ court
entries.newGeometryIntent: Maintained square house with a map room and visible window/door rhythm; reserve remaining space for the shared frontage.

entries.title: Mayor’s office and editorial room
entries.newGeometryIntent: Wide low formal residence with an audience/office bay; restrained civic identity without another castle.

entries.title: Taskmaster’s hiring office
entries.newGeometryIntent: Borrow the timber canopy and loading details only; the native stables exceed this small yard reservation.

entries.title: Joe’s map stall
entries.newGeometryIntent: Even the small Alvar cottage exceeds Joe’s 512-square envelope. Author a small lean-to/shelter; do not shrink doors or silently enlarge the lot.

entries.title: Goldur’s lodge
entries.newGeometryIntent: Plain gabled cottage at normal door scale, with a practical garden-facing side.

entries.title: Zelda’s house and drying shed
entries.newGeometryIntent: Small cottage with herb-drying details and planted court; quality comes from use and repair rather than a taller roof.

entries.title: Nadia’s house
entries.newGeometryIntent: Worn small cottage with an offset entrance and sparse trim; preserve the west-gate lane.

entries.title: Oorla’s house / Troyanna’s room
entries.newGeometryIntent: Shared study house, two interior work areas, restrained arched-window details; no need for two exterior towers.

entries.title: Gremlin court
entries.newGeometryIntent: Keep the fortified audience annex distinct from ordinary housing.

entries.title: Ellinger’s Tower
entries.preference: Mixed: Alvar arcane details, custom tower
entries.newGeometryIntent: Use the polygonal shaft/entry as a study only. Ellinger requires a much taller original composition with repeated normal-scale bays, not a stretched guild mushroom roof.

entries.title: Temple of Mok
entries.newGeometryIntent: The nave, lower side aisles and entrance porch suit Mok’s civic temple; create new symbols and preserve the taller planned nave.

entries.title: Tailor and cobbler row
entries.newGeometryIntent: Create two unequal shallow work bays for tailor/cobbler with distinct doors. Do not use the cross-shaped symmetric four-shop plan.

entries.title: Workers’ shared house
entries.newGeometryIntent: One low cottage for Daron and Tolberti; shared occupancy is supported by the Garrote/Ravenshore study, not inferred from Alvar’s single-resident table.

entries.title: Keeper’s cottage and kennel
entries.newGeometryIntent: Small shared cottage and newly fitted low kennel canopy; two residents do not imply a rich estate.

entries.title: Dyson’s public storehouse
entries.newGeometryIntent: Broad low functional storehouse with two nine-chest bays and Dyson’s desk; no imported training service or native hall mesh.
